tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Check available appointment time slots for a specified service type and date.

service_type.description: The category or type of service (e.g. consultation, inspection, support).

filler_phrases: Let me check our calendar for available {service_type} times...
Looking into the schedule for {service_type} right now...
One second while I pull up open appointment slots...

tools.name: book_appointment
tools.description: Book a confirmed appointment reservation for a customer.
filler_phrases: Booking that appointment slot for you right now...
Securing your reservation in our booking system...
One moment while I confirm your appointment details...

tools.name: lookup_order
tools.description: Look up tracking details, shipping carrier, and delivery status for an order ID.

order_id.description: The order reference ID, e.g. 'ORD-1042' or '1042'

filler_phrases: Looking up the latest tracking details for order {order_id}...
Checking the status of your order in our fulfillment system...
One moment while I pull up those shipping records...

tools.name: query_knowledge_base
tools.description: Search documentation and knowledge base for FAQs, return policies, hours, and pricing.

query.description: Natural language search query or question

category.description: Optional category filter (e.g. policies, hours, pricing)

filler_phrases: Let me check our knowledge base for that information...
Searching our policy documentation right now...
One second while I find the exact answer for you...

tools.name: execute_webhook
tools.description: Dispatch an asynchronous HTTP webhook to an external business API or endpoint.

endpoint_url.description: The destination URL or webhook identifier

filler_phrases: Dispatching request to external system, one moment...
Connecting to the external service now...

tools.name: transfer_call
tools.description: Transfer the current live caller to another telephone number, department, or human specialist.

destination.description: Target phone number or extension (E.164 format, e.g. +18885550142)

transfer_type.description: Transfer mode: blind (immediate handoff) or warm (attended with briefing)

reason.description: Reason for the transfer to provide in handoff briefing

filler_phrases: Transferring you to our {department} specialist right now, please stay on the line...
I am connecting you directly with a human representative, one moment please...
Placing you on a brief hold while I conference in our specialist...
